virals.name: Cyril
virals.hook: The 6 levels of AI maturity you can find in companies.
virals.text:
The 6 levels of AI maturity you can find in companies.

L1 Assist - Team interact with AI through manual prompts 
(Copilot, ChatGPT, ...)

L2 Connect - AI securely accesses internal company knowledge 
(RAG, Vector databases, ...)

L3 Actionable - AI chats and agents use internal tools within user permissions 
(Claude Code, Codex, MCP, ...)

L4 Autonomous - AI agents autonomously execute tasks based on triggers or schedules 
(Pi, Hermes, Openclaw, Muse, Duet, Dots, ...)

L5 Orchestrate - AI agents coordinate tasks across other AI agents and teams
(LangGraph, Mem0, ...)

L6 Self-Improve - AI agents make decisions, execute and self-improve
(Software Factory, AlphaEvolve,...)

outsiders.name: Cyril
outsiders.hook: The 6 levels of AI maturity you can find in companies.
outsiders.text:
The 6 levels of AI maturity you can find in companies.

L1 Assist - Team interact with AI through manual prompts 
(Copilot, ChatGPT, ...)

L2 Connect - AI securely accesses internal company knowledge 
(RAG, Vector databases, ...)

L3 Actionable - AI chats and agents use internal tools within user permissions 
(Claude Code, Codex, MCP, ...)

L4 Autonomous - AI agents autonomously execute tasks based on triggers or schedules 
(Pi, Hermes, Openclaw, Muse, Duet, Dots, ...)

L5 Orchestrate - AI agents coordinate tasks across other AI agents and teams
(LangGraph, Mem0, ...)

L6 Self-Improve - AI agents make decisions, execute and self-improve
(Software Factory, AlphaEvolve,...)

drafts.rides: @MSFTCopilot Claude Fable 5.2 in Cowork and Copilot Studio (28,165) + your "Microsoft just killed Claude" quote (7,783)
drafts.text:
Claude Fable 5.2 is rolling out in Copilot Studio.

Three weeks ago the debate was "which model is best?"

Now the model is a dropdown.

The agents that win next year won't be the ones on the smartest model. They'll be the ones with the best instructions, the cleanest knowledge and an owner who reads the transcripts.

Pick the model last.
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 15s screen recording: open a Copilot Studio agent, flip the model dropdown between options while the same test question gets answered, then zoom on the instructions box. Caption: 'Pick the model last.'

drafts.text:
ChatGPT now does your personal finances in the desktop app.

Meanwhile half of finance still runs on one Excel file called FINAL_v7_REAL.xlsx that only Dave understands.

The AI isn't the hard part.

Getting the data out of Dave's spreadsheet is.

Start there. Power Query, a clean table, then add the AI.
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 10s: slow zoom on a messy Excel file named FINAL_v7_REAL.xlsx with merged cells everywhere, hard cut to a clean Excel table, text pops: 'Clean table first. AI second.'

drafts.rides: @OpenAIDevs Codex founder story 30,000 visitors in 4 days (71,568) + @msdev 1,211 PRs (21,257)
drafts.text:
One founder. Codex. 30,000 visitors in under 4 days.

The lesson isn't "AI writes code now."

It's that shipping got cheap, so picking the right problem is the whole job.

Same thing in Power Platform: the app takes an afternoon now. Figuring out which process deserves an app still takes a conversation with the people doing the work.
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 12s talking head: hold up a sticky note that says 'build it' and toss it, then hold up one that says 'which problem?' and stick it on the camera. Caption: 'Shipping got cheap.'

drafts.rides: @burkeholland Image Generation in GitHub Copilot (5,354) + @code release (24,867)
drafts.text:
Image generation just landed in GitHub Copilot and Burke's tip is the real feature:

Mock the screen first. Then have the agent build from the image.

Works for Power Apps too. Generate the screen you want, drop it into the conversation, and stop describing "a nice modern layout" in 400 words.

Show, don't prompt.
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 15s split screen: left side a generated app mockup image, right side the agent building it live, sped up 8x. End frame text: 'Show, don't prompt.'

drafts.rides: outsider @HeyToha "Your AI agent might be lying to you" (36,878) + your harness posts
drafts.text:
"Your AI agent might be lying to you" did huge numbers this week.

It's not lying. It's guessing, because nobody told it what to do when a tool call fails.

Before you ship a Copilot Studio agent:

1. Break a connector on purpose
2. Read the transcript
3. Make it say "I couldn't do that" instead of "Done!"

Test the failure, not the demo.
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 12s: screen shows an agent replying 'Done! Your request is submitted ✅', cut to the flow run history showing a red Failed status. Caption: 'Test the failure, not the demo.'
